verdict.rationale: The only browser-control evidence is the Gemini API Computer Use tool, a developer building block for constructing your own agents; the evidence itself treats that API as a separate product from the Gemini assistant app. Nothing shows the consumer assistant operating a browser on the user's behalf. Deep Research gathers information through Google Search, and Connected Apps acts inside linked apps; both are adjacent features, not browser operation.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can have the assistant operate a web browser on my behalf to research and complete tasks on websites
